name: English Podcast Production
description: An episode-production report with an editorial summary, chapters, attributable quotes, and fact-check leads.

sections.title: Episode summary
sections.objective: Write a concise listener-oriented summary of the episode's main subjects and conclusions without promotional invention.

sections.title: Suggested chapter markers
sections.objective: Propose useful chapter boundaries when the conversation changes topic, using exact transcript timing and short descriptive titles.

output_fields.label: Start
output_fields.description: Chapter start time in the recording.

sections.title: Notable quotes
sections.objective: Select concise, representative verbatim quotations and attribute each one to the transcript's actual speaker.

output_fields.label: Speaker
output_fields.description: Speaker who said the quoted words.

sections.title: Fact-check candidates
sections.objective: Identify checkable factual claims that may warrant editorial verification; do not claim that a statement is false merely because it needs checking.

output_fields.label: Claim
output_fields.description: Checkable claim as stated or closely paraphrased.
